notes.title: Fixed some lingering bugs... (Patch 1.06)
notes.content:
We've squashed a few bugs that managed to stick around during the launch of the game:
[list]

[*] The Druids first few voice lines now play when they are supposed to
[*] Movement has now been disabled while the credits are rolling at the end of the game
[/list]
Thank you all for the support for Soul of the Forest!
